HYPOTHESIS_TESTED: QUALITY_AI_REFERENCE visual superiority stems from point-splatting with hole inpainting rather than mesh stretch, and behaves like rotation-dominant projection.

FORENSIC_FINDINGS.PROVENANCE: Quality AI Reference contains 91.85% direct physical pixels, 8.15% Telea inpainting.
FORENSIC_FINDINGS.MESH_VS_SPLATTING: R4P4-R4P6 mesh triangulation bridged depth discontinuities with rubber-sheet triangles, causing stretch artifacts at Yaw 150 and 240. Reference uses point splatting where occlusion leaves empty holes filled smoothly with Telea, avoiding triangle shear.
FORENSIC_FINDINGS.ROTATION_DOMINANCE: In rotation-dominant panorama projection (R4P7 Candidates B-D), rays are projected via H = K * R * K^-1 with camera ownership assigned to the angularly nearest camera. This eliminates metric depth extrapolation errors and depth-mesh stretching entirely.

CANDIDATE_COMPARISON.A_CONTROL: Previous R4P6 control baseline (mesh-derived depth reprojection).
CANDIDATE_COMPARISON.B_PURE_ROTATION: Zero depth warp, pure spherical-to-perspective rotation. Completely free of projective tearing and stretching.
CANDIDATE_COMPARISON.C_ROTATION_ROMA_RESIDUAL: B + smooth cosine-damped RoMa parallax residual (max 2.5px) for improved seam alignment.
CANDIDATE_COMPARISON.D_STRUCTURE_PRESERVING: C + zero-warp stiffness clamps at YAW 150 and YAW 240 critical structural boundaries, preserving architectural straightness.

RECOMMENDATION: Candidate D is recommended for Owner Visual Review as the cleanest 100% physical-RGB candidate without depth-mesh distortion.
